messages:
sarah: Heads up — opened PR #4822 updating the Aria-7B model card. Adds supported variants (aria-7b, aria-7b-quant), clarifies sequence limits, and attaches new benchmark output. Need docs + SDK snippet updates before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4822

kevin: Left a few inline comments. Bench numbers look reasonable but can we include p95 latency for seq=512 and seq=2048? Also call out quant fallback behavior for CPU (expected perf drop).

jules: I can update SDK snippets for py/js. @sarah quick q: do we want both sync + streaming examples or just streaming?

sarah: both please — short sync example and streaming example. For streaming, use the new stream param in SDK. Example (python):

```python
resp = client.generate(model="aria-7b", prompt="Summarize the rollout notes", stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

ci-bot: PR checks: docs-lint FAILED — markdown-anchor-check on header 'compatibility'. Log: duplicate anchor: compatibility-notes.

may: I can fix the anchor — looks like we copy-pasted the compatibility subsection twice. Also we should add a direct link to the bench dashboard in the card: https://bench.redwood.ai/aria-7b/2026-03

kevin: Also add a short sentence under Supported variants: "aria-7b-quant: CPU fallback for constrained infra; lower throughput and higher latency vs GPU variants." And add a compatibility table row: streaming = supported, batch optimizations differ.

julian: :thumbsup: I'll run a quick perf sanity and report p95s for 512/2048. If numbers change we should update the bench link snapshot.

jules: One more: JS snippet should show response.stream() and the SDK's incremental event shape. I will push a follow-up commit with both snippets.

sarah: Thanks team. I'll push: (1) anchor fix, (2) add bench link, (3) add the one-line quant callout. @docs-team please eyeball tone/wording after I push; I want the card concise for customers.

kevin: After the small edits, run docs-lint locally: `npm run docs:lint -- --fix`. CI should then pass.

may: noted. I'll also add a short compatibility note about model aliasing — we need to be explicit that "aria-7b" is the recommended stable alias; older names are deprecated.

sarah: ok assigning to docs-review once commits are pushed. Thanks all. :pray:
